item_name: Rothco Jumbo 80MM Carabiner With Web Strap Key Ring
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Jumbo 80MM Carabiner with Web Strap Key Ring is the perfect solution for anyone needing a convenient and secure way to carry their keys and small items. Available in black, olive drab, and woodland camo, the carabiner’s robust design ensures durability while its lightweight structure makes it easy to carry without adding bulk.
